about: Controller tracking take (docs/research/ctrl-tracking-improvements.md, 'Live takes'): the steps for the app's guided recording, in the rec_steps format of app/src/core/rec_steps.h (only "steps" is read). The recording around it: the inside-out session running (Monado + pibridge-ctrltrack live), pibridge-cam record OUT.pxcam --source broker for the whole script, PIMAX_CTRL_IMU_LOG set for the session (the fuser log of both hands). Do it twice: with PIMAX_CAM_AE=1 (the LED frames at the Windows pair 40/62) and with PIMAX_CAM_AE=0 (25/35). About 2.2 GB per minute.

steps.text: Put the headset on. Pick up both controllers and press a button on each.
Hold both controllers still at chest height in front of you.
Point around normally, with your arms low and to the sides.
Swing the controllers fast and flick your wrists, in front and to the sides.
Put your left hand behind your back and keep it there.
Bring your left hand back in front of you.
Now put your right hand behind your back and keep it there.
Bring your right hand back in front of you.
Cross your hands, and hold one controller behind the other.
Put both controllers down on the desk in front of you and leave them there.
Turn the room light off now, if you can. Keep looking at the desk.
Done. You can turn the light back on.
